q1_issues.issue: The kind word 'Index' sits inside the capitalized name run, so the name rule requires an ordinary type atom (Member standard_and_poors_500_index index) beside the Name fact, and none is emitted.
'to 1,069.42' (the index's resulting level) is put in Goal, which the instruction set defines as the spatial non-recipient 'to' oblique, and its filler is a bare number rather than an entity term.
The Measure scale 'fall' is taken from the verb, whereas the instruction set fixes the scale as the stated gradable adjective or the dimension noun.

q2_gaps: A parenthetical ticker / secondary identifier ('<.SPX>') — the instruction set allows exactly one Name fact per proper noun and gives no slot for an alternate code, so it is silently dropped.

Appositive / restatement 'or' ('0.70 points, or 0.07 percent' — the same change re-expressed in another unit), which is not a disjunction; the Disjunction section treats every 'or' as inclusive disjunction.
The resulting numeric value of a change-of-value verb ('fell ... to 1,069.42') — no licensed endpoint-value encoding (Measure needs a unit, Goal is spatial).
notes: Reading the two magnitudes as one fall measured two ways (rather than as an (Or ...)) is the semantically right call, but it is not what the Disjunction section as written prescribes. Patient on the intransitive change-of-state subject and Past are correct.
